courses.title: Complete Freelancing Masterclass
courses.shortDescription: Live online training in complete freelancing masterclass for women who want practical, home-friendly skills.
courses.description: LIVE ONLINE TRAINING – NOT A RECORDED COURSE. This one-month Zoom programme focuses on freelancing platforms, client communication and remote work readiness. You will attend four live classes each week, complete practical exercises and take part in question-and-answer sessions with the instructor. You can apply these skills on platforms such as Fiverr or Upwork, or when applying for remote support roles. Intakes are planned for the 1st of every month. Exact class days and timings are shared with registered participants after enrolment. Classes are interactive; this is not a pre-recorded video course.
courses.schedule: Four live classes per week. Exact class days and timings will be shared with registered participants.
learningOutcomes: Set up professional profiles on major freelance platforms
Write clear proposals and respond to client briefings
Price basic services with simple cost awareness
Communicate professionally with remote clients
requirements: Smartphone or computer with a stable internet connection
Willingness to attend scheduled live Zoom sessions
Notebook or digital document for exercises and notes
Email account and ability to create profiles on public platforms
